title: Habitify micro-interaction reel (dnyxstudios)
summary: An 11 s square reel of isolated iOS-style UI components, one at a time, centred on a flat light-grey canvas: app icon, + button, 'Create Good Habit' pill, a form sheet, a tab bar, a streak grid, a widget, a book card and a check. Each one morphs or springs into the next while a hand cursor taps it. Clean, tactile, Dribbble-shot energy.
fit_reason: 'One component at a time on a plain canvas, tapped by a cursor' is the cleanest way to show one SaaSSuite feature in under 12 s; looks premium with zero footage.

palette.mood: light neutral iOS grey with iOS-blue, charcoal cards and one warm orange hit

typography.display: SF Pro / Inter semibold, UI-native sizes
typography.size_behaviour: small, only inside components; no headlines
typography.notes: Text inside components often types or morphs letter by letter with motion blur (2.2 s 'reate Good' mid-morph; 3.3 s 'Enter Habit...' with mixed sizes as letters settle).

text_animation: per-letter morph/scramble as one component's label becomes the next
text slides in with heavy directional motion blur
labels settle with a slight scale and baseline bounce
motion: single centred object morphs shape-to-shape (icon -> circle button -> pill -> sheet -> tab bar -> widget -> card -> check)
3D tilt/rotate on entry (pill enters skewed at 2.2 s)
tab bar slides in from the left with motion blur
hand cursor (macOS-style pointing hand) enters, taps with a press-scale, leaves
transitions: fast directional slide with motion blur
final hard cut to dark vignette signature card
graphic_elements: iOS components: FAB, pill button, form sheet, tab bar, habit streak grid, widget, book progress card
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI components isolated one at a time, centred, at ~40-60% frame width, no device frame, no background UI

sound.music: short upbeat lo-fi / pluck loop (loud, -9 LUFS)
sound.sfx: taps and pops on each click and morph
sound.sync: each morph lands on a beat

signature_moves: one object on screen at all times that keeps morphing into the next UI component
flat #e5e4e9 canvas with no other decoration

best_segments.what: + button tapped, morphs into 'Create Good Habit' pill then expands into a form sheet
Tab bar slides in and is tapped, becomes a streak grid, widget, orange book card, then a blue check

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP with Flip/MorphSVG: one container div whose width, height, radius and fill are tweened with spring easing; swap inner content with a 0.15 s blur crossfade; cursor sprite with press scale 0.9. Blur via CSS filter on fast moves.
recreate.prompt: Square flat #e5e4e9 canvas; a single centred iOS-style component keeps morphing into the next (app icon -> blue #0b8df8 + button -> charcoal pill 'Create Good Habit' -> form sheet -> tab bar -> widget -> orange card -> blue check), each tapped by a pointing-hand cursor, springy overshoot, motion-blurred label morphs, upbeat pluck loop.
